glossEn: a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
note: a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values。线索：attitude towards / to + sth。最常用义。

glossEn: a theatrical pose created for effect
note: a theatrical pose created for effect。线索：strike / adopt an attitude。注意与 s3 区分：本条指身体摆出的姿势，s3 指航天器姿态。

glossEn: position of aircraft or spacecraft relative to a frame of reference (the horizon or direction of motion)
note: position of aircraft or spacecraft relative to a frame of reference。技术义：attitude control / satellite attitude。现有中文无对应，属新增。与 s2 的判别句：He struck a theatrical attitude. / The satellite changed its attitude.
